title: Approximating parametric suprema for constructible and power-constructible functions
summary: We prove that one may approximate parametric suprema of constructible and power-constructible functions using functions within the same class. This resolves a conjecture by Adiceam and Cluckers, which was posited after studying a question posed by Sarnak. We apply our result to prove that a certain subclass of Cexp-class distributions is tempered and to make uniform a bound concerning pushforward measures.
